jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Ein einjähriges kaufmännisches Praktikum als Praxisteil für deinen EFZ-Abschluss

• Du erhältst Einblick in verschiedene Abteilungen wie Content & Product Management, Einkauf, Administration und Verkauf

• Im Tagesgeschäft übernimmst du administrative, organisatorische und kommunikative Aufgaben

• In Aktivitäten und Projekten kannst du deine Interessen einbringen, passend zu deinen Lernzielen

• Du lernst, wie E-Commerce für Privatkund:innen und Geschäftskund:innen funktioniert

• Ab dem ersten Arbeitstag steht dir ein persönlicher Laptop zur Verfügung

• Deine Lernbegleitung und die Berufsbildungsverantwortlichen unterstützen dich während des Praktikums

• Du sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung für deinen Einstieg ins Berufsleben

Anforderungen:
• Du schliesst per August 2027 eine Handels- oder Mittelschule ab und benötigst ein einjähriges Praktikum für den EFZ-Abschluss

• Stilsicheres Deutsch sowie gute Schulkenntnisse in Französisch und Englisch

• Freude an kaufmännischen Aufgaben, Organisation und Kommunikation

• Interesse an E-Commerce, Handel und Marketing

• Zuverlässige, selbständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise

• Offene Persönlichkeit mit Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team

• Motivation, praktische Erfahrung zu sammeln und Neues zu lernen

• Interesse daran, unterschiedliche Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen

Wir bieten:
• Vergünstigungen: Attraktive Vergünstigungen im Brack-Onlineshop sowie Mittagessenvergünstigungen und Personalrestaurants in Mägenwil und Willisau.

• Erholung: Mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien, zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit für Ferienkauf und unbezahlten Urlaub.

• Entwicklung: Interne Ausbildungen in der eigenen Academy sowie finanzielle Beteiligung an externen Weiterbildungen.

• Familie: 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub mit Verlängerungsmöglichkeit und 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub.

• Versicherungen: Überobligatorisch – 100% Lohnfortzahlung sowie vollständige Finanzierung der Krankentaggeldversicherung durch den Arbeitgeber.

• Mobilität: Gratisparkplätze, finanzielle Beteiligung an den ÖV und Poolfahrzeuge für Geschäftstermine.

"Gemeinsam gestalten wir den Handel von morgen" Brack.Alltron beschäftigt rund 1300 Mitarbeitende und erwirtschaftet über eine Milliarde Umsatz. Das Unternehmen gibt es, weil ein Mensch den Mut hatte, neue Wege zu finden und sie zu gehen. Unsere Erfolgsgeschichte zeigt, dass durch jeden Einzelnen, gemeinsam etwas Grosses entsteht und wir lieben unsere Einzigartigkeit. Wir setzen uns ambitionierte Ziele, dabei ist es uns sehr wichtig, dass wir verantwortlich handeln, uns gegenseitig fördern und fordern und Freude haben an dem, was wir tagtäglich tun.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Compiti:
• Uno stage commerciale di un anno come parte pratica del vostro grado EFZ

• Ottieni informazioni su vari dipartimenti come Content & Product Management, Acquisti, Amministrazione e Vendite

• In attività quotidiane, si assume compiti amministrativi, organizzativi e di comunicazione

• Nelle attività e nei progetti puoi contribuire ai tuoi interessi, abbinando i tuoi obiettivi di apprendimento

• Imparerai come l'e-commerce funziona per i clienti privati: interni e clienti aziendali: interni

• Dal primo giorno lavorativo è disponibile un portatile personale

• Il vostro sostegno all'apprendimento e i responsabili della formazione professionale vi sostengono durante lo stage

• Ottieni preziosa esperienza pratica per il tuo ingresso nella vita lavorativa

Requisiti
• Si laurea da una scuola commerciale o media a partire da agosto 2027 e ha bisogno di uno stage di un anno per la laurea EFZ

• Stylistic tedesco e buone competenze scolastiche in francese e inglese

• Attività commerciali, organizzazione e comunicazione

• Interessi di e-commerce, commercio e marketing

• Metodi di lavoro affidabili, indipendenti e responsabili

• Personalità aperta con piacere nel lavorare insieme in un team

• Motivazione, acquisire esperienza pratica e imparare cose nuove

• Interessato a conoscere diverse aree dell'azienda

Offriamo:
• Perchi: Percorsi interessanti nel negozio online di Brack, così come i pasti e i ristoranti del personale a Mägenwil e Willisau.

• Ricreazione: Almeno 5 settimane di vacanza, inoltre c'è la possibilità di acquisto di vacanza e vacanza non pagata.

• Sviluppo: Formazione interna alla propria Accademia e partecipazione finanziaria all'ulteriore istruzione esterna.

• Famiglia: 18 settimane di congedo di maternità retribuito con prolungamento e 4 settimane di congedo di paternità pagato.

• Assicurazione: Supercompulsory – 100% paga continuata e pieno finanziamento dell'assicurazione malattia da parte del datore di lavoro.

• Mobilità: parcheggio gratuito, partecipazione finanziaria ai trasporti pubblici e veicoli a bordo piscina per riunioni di lavoro.

"Insieme formiamo il commercio di domani" Brack. Alltron impiega circa 1300 dipendenti e genera oltre un miliardo di vendite. L'azienda esiste perché una persona ha avuto il coraggio di trovare nuovi modi e andare loro. La nostra storia di successo mostra che attraverso ogni individuo, qualcosa di grande è creato insieme e amiamo la nostra unicità. Ci siamo posti obiettivi ambiziosi, ma è molto importante per noi che agiamo responsabilmente, promuoviamo e ci sfidiamo e godiamo ciò che facciamo ogni giorno.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
• A one-year commercial internship as a practical part of your EFZ degree

• You get insight into various departments such as Content & Product Management, Purchasing, Administration and Sales

• In day-to-day business, you take on administrative, organizational and communication tasks

• In activities and projects you can contribute your interests, matching your learning goals

• You will learn how e-commerce works for private customers:inside and business customers:inside

• From the first working day you have a personal laptop available

• Your learning support and those responsible for vocational training support you during the internship

• You gain valuable practical experience for your entry into working life

Requirements
• You graduate from a commercial or middle school as of August 2027 and need a one-year internship for the EFZ degree

• Stylistic German and good school skills in French and English

• Enjoying commercial tasks, organization and communication

• Interest in e-commerce, trade and marketing

• Reliable, independent and responsible working methods

• Open personality with pleasure in working together in a team

• Motivation, gaining practical experience and learning new things

• Interested in getting to know different areas of the company

We offer:
• Perks: Attractive perks in the Brack online shop as well as lunch perks and staff restaurants in Mägenwil and Willisau.

• Recreation: At least 5 weeks of vacation, in addition there is the possibility for holiday purchase and unpaid vacation.

• Development: Internal training in the own Academy as well as financial participation in external further education.

• Family: 18 weeks of paid maternity leave with extension and 4 weeks of paid paternity leave.

• Insurance: Supercompulsory – 100% continued pay and full financing of the sickness allowance insurance by the employer.

• Mobility: free parking, financial participation in public transport and pool vehicles for business meetings.

"Together we shape the trade of tomorrow" Brack.Alltron employs around 1300 employees and generates over one billion sales. The company exists because a person had the courage to find new ways and go them. Our success story shows that through each individual, something great is created together and we love our uniqueness. We set ourselves ambitious goals, but it is very important to us that we act responsibly, promote and challenge each other and enjoy what we do every day.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Tâches :
• Un stage commercial d'un an comme partie pratique de votre diplôme EFZ

• Vous obtenez un aperçu de différents départements tels que la gestion du contenu et des produits, les achats, l'administration et les ventes

• Dans les affaires quotidiennes, vous assumez des tâches administratives, organisationnelles et de communication

• Dans les activités et les projets, vous pouvez contribuer à vos intérêts, en adéquation avec vos objectifs d'apprentissage

• Vous apprendrez comment l'e-commerce fonctionne pour les clients privés: à l'intérieur et les clients d'affaires: à l'intérieur

• Dès le premier jour ouvrable, vous avez un ordinateur portable personnel disponible

• Votre soutien à l'apprentissage et les responsables de la formation professionnelle vous accompagnent pendant le stage

• Vous gagnez une expérience pratique précieuse pour votre entrée dans la vie active

Exigences
• Vous êtes diplômé d'une école commerciale ou secondaire en août 2027 et avez besoin d'un stage d'un an pour le diplôme EFZ

• Allemand styliste et bonnes compétences scolaires en français et anglais

• Profitez des tâches commerciales, de l'organisation et de la communication

• Intérêt pour le commerce électronique, le commerce et la commercialisation

• Méthodes de travail fiables, indépendantes et responsables

• Personnalité ouverte avec plaisir à travailler ensemble en équipe

• Motivation, acquisition d'une expérience pratique et apprentissage de nouvelles choses

• Intéressé à découvrir différents domaines de l'entreprise

Nous offrons:
• Avantages: Des avantages attrayants dans la boutique en ligne Brack ainsi que des avantages pour le déjeuner et les restaurants du personnel à Mägenwil et Willisau.

• Loisirs: Au moins 5 semaines de vacances, en plus il ya la possibilité d'acheter des vacances et des vacances non payées.

• Développement: formation interne dans la propre Académie ainsi que participation financière à l'enseignement complémentaire externe.

• Famille : 18 semaines de congé de maternité payé avec prolongation et 4 semaines de congé de paternité payé.

• Assurance : Superobligatoire – 100% de la rémunération continue et le financement intégral de l'assurance maladie par l'employeur.

• Mobilité: parking gratuit, participation financière dans les transports publics et les véhicules de piscine pour les réunions d'affaires.

"Ensemble nous façonnons le commerce de demain" Brack. Alltron emploie environ 1300 employés et génère plus d'un milliard de ventes. L'entreprise existe parce qu'une personne a eu le courage de trouver de nouvelles façons de les faire. Notre success story montre qu'à travers chaque individu, quelque chose de grand est créé ensemble et nous aimons notre unicité. Nous nous fixons des objectifs ambitieux, mais il est très important pour nous d'agir de manière responsable, de nous promouvoir, de nous défier mutuellement et de profiter de ce que nous faisons chaque jour.

• È possibile estendere e espandere i diversi anni di esperienza professionale (preferibilmente nell'ambiente industriale) con noi

• Si mantiene un modo indipendente e affidabile di lavorare e godere di lavorare in un team

• Le ore di lavoro abituali sono da lunedì a venerdì dalle 07:00 alle 17:00 circa (flessibilità per missioni speciali dalle 06:00 alle 20:00 e sporadiche missioni del sabato è desiderato)

Offriamo:
• Perks: Perk interessanti nel negozio online di Brack, nonché perks di pranzo e ristoranti di personale a Mägenwil e Willisau.

• Sviluppo: Formazione interna alla propria Accademia e partecipazione finanziaria all'ulteriore istruzione esterna.

• Famiglia: 18 settimane di congedo di maternità retribuito con prolungamento e 4 settimane di congedo di paternità pagato.

• In a team of four, you are responsible for the maintenance of the intralogistics system and ensure the availability, reliability and safety of all systems.

Tasks:
• You take entrepreneurial responsibility for your appearance and know how to keep quiet. Also over a whole minute. Or five.

• You let yourself be convinced that leisure is not a flaw, but a valued expertise.

• You ensure consistently high quality in the areas of eye contact, sitting position, tail posture and general grandeur.

• If necessary, you make self-initiative acoustic statements in the form of meows, purrs or meaningful silence.

• You work independently and reliably – or at least convincingly convey the impression that everything was planned exactly as planned.

• A humble and cat-fearing camera team is always at your side.

• There is no classic salary – but a Brack voucher worth 1,000 francs for your biped.

Requirements
• You have completed basic training in the kitten field; Cross-enterers with a distinct natural talent are also welcome.

• Further training in the field of two-legged management, posing and catwalk is advantageous.

• Thou art a sure meow in word and writing.

• You have over 2-3 years of professional experience in dealing with bipeds.

• Cameras and cameramen are not scratch trees for you. Please.

• You can sit still and keep the equipment at least 70% safe. Or 60% ... by 60% we are already happy.

• You use your chocolate side immaculately – in case of doubt also the other.

• Even with spontaneous strokes and snack breaks you keep the peace.

Important for your application
Only an animal cat is sought, applications from bipeds are not sighted. Keepers can fill out the application form from the point of view of their cat. Only a small profile to the cat and a picture are required, an application dossier is not necessary. With the application, the owners agree that the pictures and videos submitted by them together with the name of the cat are excluded from the data protection declaration and may be further used and published. By participating in the casting, the owner of the winning cat additionally agrees that the photo and video recordings of the cat taken during the shooting may also be used and published.

Seul un chat animal est recherché, les applications de bipédistes ne sont pas vues. Les gardiens peuvent remplir le formulaire de demande du point de vue de leur chat. jobs.description:

descriptionByLocale.it:
Compiti:
• Responsabilità per il supporto operativo e lo sviluppo strategico della nostra gamma nel settore della sicurezza fisica, compresi gli obiettivi di budget, ricavi e contributi

• Costruire e sviluppare ulteriormente un portafoglio di prodotti attraente e competitivo intorno alla robotica, AI fisico e droni commerciali per i nostri canali di vendita B2C, B2B e commercio

• Stabilimento e manutenzione di partnership a lungo termine con produttori e fornitori internazionali, soprattutto in Asia, nonché negoziazione indipendente di condizioni attraenti

• Tenere sempre d'occhio le tendenze del mercato e le nuove tecnologie, identificare il potenziale e aprire nuove opportunità di business per la nostra gamma

• Analisi dei dati chiave rilevanti nonché controllo del fatturato e del margine di contribuzione, incluso il trattamento dei bonus del produttore, sconti e crediti

• Pianificazione e realizzazione di misure di marketing mirate in stretta collaborazione con i nostri produttori e con il Responsabile Marketing Categoria

• Una stretta collaborazione con le vendite, l'acquisto, la commercializzazione e la contabilità nonché il coordinamento attivo delle varie interfacce

Requisiti
• Formazione di base commerciale o tecnica completata (EFZ), integrata idealmente da una ulteriore formazione nella gestione dei prodotti, marketing, acquisto o amministrazione aziendale

• Vantaggioso 2-3 anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione del prodotto, nella gestione della categoria o in una funzione di mercato simile, preferibilmente nell'ambiente ICT, commerciale o e-commerce

• Enthusiasm per tecnologie innovative e un'alta affinità per la tecnologia di sicurezza, il monitoraggio e le soluzioni di controllo degli accessi o droni.

• Buona conoscenza del mercato svizzero delle TIC e dei suoi canali di distribuzione. Una rete esistente nel canale, così come l'esperienza nel business del progetto o con offerte sono vantaggiose

• Il pensiero analitico e imprenditoriale, un metodo di lavoro indipendente e strutturato e un buon senso delle opportunità di mercato e delle esigenze del cliente

• Forte capacità di negoziazione, capacità di comunicazione e un atteggiamento sicuro nel trattare i partner commerciali internazionali

• Personalità impegnata e orientata al team con un alto livello di iniziativa, che ama mettere in discussione i processi esistenti, portare nuove idee e pensare al di fuori della scatola

• Conoscenza di stile-confidente del tedesco e molto buona conoscenza dell'inglese in parola e scrittura. Le competenze francesi e italiane sono utili

• Gestione sicura delle applicazioni M365, in particolare di Excel, nonché il piacere di lavorare con dati, metriche e analisi

Offriamo:
• Perchi: Percorsi interessanti nel negozio online di Brack, così come i pasti e i ristoranti del personale a Mägenwil e Willisau.

• Ricreazione: Almeno 5 settimane di vacanza, inoltre c'è la possibilità di acquisto di vacanza e vacanza non pagata.

• Sviluppo: Formazione interna alla propria Accademia e partecipazione finanziaria all'ulteriore istruzione esterna.

• Famiglia: 18 settimane di congedo di maternità retribuito con prolungamento e 4 settimane di congedo di paternità pagato.

• Assicurazione: Supercompulsory – 100% paga continuata e pieno finanziamento dell'assicurazione malattia da parte del datore di lavoro.

• Mobilità: parcheggio gratuito, partecipazione finanziaria ai trasporti pubblici e veicoli a bordo piscina per riunioni di lavoro.

"Insieme formiamo il commercio di domani" Brack. Alltron impiega circa 1300 dipendenti e genera oltre un miliardo di vendite. L'azienda esiste perché una persona ha avuto il coraggio di trovare nuovi modi e andare loro. La nostra storia di successo mostra che attraverso ogni individuo, qualcosa di grande è creato insieme e amiamo la nostra unicità. Ci siamo posti obiettivi ambiziosi, ma è molto importante per noi che agiamo responsabilmente, promuoviamo e ci sfidiamo e godiamo ciò che facciamo ogni giorno.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
• Responsibility for the operational support and strategic development of our range in the area of physical security including budget, revenue and contribution targets

• Building and further developing an attractive and competitive product portfolio around robotics, physical AI and commercial drones for our sales channels B2C, B2B and trade

• Establishment and maintenance of long-term partnerships with international manufacturers and suppliers, especially in Asia, as well as independent negotiation of attractive conditions

• Always keep an eye on market trends and new technologies, identify potential and open up new business opportunities for our range

• Analysis of relevant key figures as well as controlling of turnover and contribution margin including processing of manufacturer bonuses, rebates and credits

• Planning and implementation of targeted marketing measures in close cooperation with our manufacturers and the Category Marketing Manager

• Close cooperation with sales, purchasing, marketing and accounting as well as active coordination of the various interfaces

Requirements
• Completed commercial or technical basic training (EFZ), ideally supplemented by further training in product management, marketing, purchasing or business administration

• Advantageous 2–3 years of professional experience in product management, category management or in a comparable go-to-market function, preferably in the ICT, commercial or e-commerce environment

• Enthusiasm for innovative technologies as well as a high affinity for security technology, monitoring and access control solutions or drones.

• Good knowledge of the Swiss ICT market and its distribution channels. An existing network in the channel, as well as experience in the project business or with tenders are advantageous

• Analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, an independent, structured working method and a good sense of market opportunities and customer needs

• Strong negotiation skills, communication skills and a secure attitude in dealing with international business partners

• Engaged and team-oriented personality with a high level of initiative, who likes to question existing processes, bring new ideas and think outside the box

• Style-confident knowledge of German and very good knowledge of English in word and writing. French and Italian skills are beneficial

• Secure handling of M365 applications, especially Excel, as well as enjoyment of working with data, metrics and analyses

We offer:
• Perks: Attractive perks in the Brack online shop as well as lunch perks and staff restaurants in Mägenwil and Willisau.

• Recreation: At least 5 weeks of vacation, in addition there is the possibility for holiday purchase and unpaid vacation.

• Development: Internal training in the own Academy as well as financial participation in external further education.

• Family: 18 weeks of paid maternity leave with extension and 4 weeks of paid paternity leave.

• Insurance: Supercompulsory – 100% continued pay and full financing of the sickness allowance insurance by the employer.

• Mobility: free parking, financial participation in public transport and pool vehicles for business meetings.

"Together we shape the trade of tomorrow" Brack.Alltron employs around 1300 employees and generates over one billion sales. The company exists because a person had the courage to find new ways and go them. Our success story shows that through each individual, something great is created together and we love our uniqueness. We set ourselves ambitious goals, but it is very important to us that we act responsibly, promote and challenge each other and enjoy what we do every day.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
• Responsibility for the practical implementation of the requirements of Swiss data protection law and our internal data protection guidelines

• Consulting, training and sensitization of employees and executives on data protection topics related to e-commerce, tracking, analytics, CRM, payment or marketing automation

• Interpretation and application of legal requirements in the processing of personal data

• Central point of contact for data subjects and authorities, in particular the EPPO

• Further development of data protection-compliant processes, guidelines and documentation along the entire customer journey

• Evaluation of new tools and data processing, including risk analysis and assessment of the need for a data protection impact assessment

• Responsibility for establishing and continuously updating the inventory of handling activities

• Support in the examination and control of contract processors and their contractual protection

• Deputy and support our corporate lawyer in legal matters

Requirements
• Completed law studies and practical experience in the data protection and compliance environment

• Very good knowledge of the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG) and security in its practical application

• Technical understanding of digital systems and relationships such as webshops, tracking technologies, API interfaces and CRM architectures

• Ideally, experience in e-commerce or in a comparable digitally shaped business model

• Structured and analytical working method combined with a pragmatic solution approach

• Ability to convey complex legal and data protection issues in an understandable and addressable manner

• Enjoy taking on responsibility independently while working closely with interdisciplinary teams

We offer:
• Perks: Attractive perks in the Brack online shop as well as lunch perks and staff restaurants in Mägenwil and Willisau.

• Recreation: At least 5 weeks of vacation, in addition there is the possibility for holiday purchase and unpaid vacation.

• Development: Internal training in the own Academy as well as financial participation in external further education.

• Family: 18 weeks of paid maternity leave with extension and 4 weeks of paid paternity leave.

• Insurance: Supercompulsory – 100% continued pay and full financing of the sickness allowance insurance by the employer.

• Mobility: free parking, financial participation in public transport and pool vehicles for business meetings.

"Together we shape the trade of tomorrow" Brack.Alltron employs around 1300 employees and generates over one billion sales. The company exists because a person had the courage to find new ways and go them. Our success story shows that through each individual, something great is created together and we love our uniqueness. We set ourselves ambitious goals, but it is very important to us that we act responsibly, promote and challenge each other and enjoy what we do every day.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
• Operational support and further development of the assigned Household & Living ranges taking into account the category strategy and objectives

• Responsibility for achieving budget targets including controlling revenue and contribution margin as well as implementing strategic and operational product range targets

• Independent management of manufacturer and supplier negotiations as well as evaluation and inclusion of new partners and suitable sources of supply based on market and trend analyses

• Responsibility for collecting and maintaining master data, triggering article openings and creating relevant reporting and manufacturer billing

• Co-design of marketing and communication priorities as well as their implementation in close cooperation with marketing and sales

• Implementation of the pricing strategy across all sales channels and coordination between manufacturers, sales, marketing and other internal interfaces

• Close cooperation with purchasing in the implementation of the procurement strategy, the control of warehouse upper limits and target ranges as well as automated ordering processes

Requirements
• Basic commercial training with an EGZ or equivalent, preferably in the field of trade or e-commerce

• A further education in marketing, product management, purchasing or business administration

• 2–3 years of professional experience as a Product Manager: in or in a comparable job and corresponding industry knowledge

• Good MS-Office knowledge and a strong understanding of economic relationships and key figures

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing and good knowledge of English

• An independent and efficient working method, a high level of initiative as well as analytical and networked thinking

• Entrepreneurial action, strong communication and negotiation, solution orientation and enjoyment of working together in a team

We offer:
• Perks: Attractive perks in the Brack online shop as well as lunch perks and staff restaurants in Mägenwil and Willisau.

• Recreation: At least 5 weeks of vacation, in addition there is the possibility for holiday purchase and unpaid vacation.

• Development: Internal training in the own Academy as well as financial participation in external further education.

• Family: 18 weeks of paid maternity leave with extension and 4 weeks of paid paternity leave.

• Insurance: Super-compulsory – 100% continued pay and full financing of the sickness allowance insurance by the employer.

• Mobility: free parking, financial participation in public transport and pool vehicles for business appointments.

"Together we shape the trade of tomorrow" Brack.Alltron employs around 1300 employees and generates over one billion turnover. We set ourselves ambitious goals, but it is very important to us that we act responsibly, promote and challenge each other and enjoy what we do every day.
